title: Circuit evaluation from satisfied Tseitin clauses
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ assign a truth proposition to every input or gate variable of a tree circuit on $n$ inputs, and let $u$ be a Boolean assignment to its inputs. Suppose that $u(i)$ is true exactly when $\alpha$ makes input $i$ true, for every input $i$. If all clauses in the Tseitin formula of a tree circuit $C$ are satisfied by $\alpha$, then $C$ evaluates to true under $u$ exactly when $\alpha$ makes the gate variable for $C$ true.
hypotheses_covered: For every input $i$, $u(i)=\mathrm{true}$ iff $\alpha$ makes input $i$ true
The Tseitin formula of $C$ is satisfied by $\alpha$
